Role: Compliance Officer & Money Laundering Reporting Officer (CO/MLRO)
Primary Location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Regulatory Status: Approved Person – Compliance Officer & MLRO (FSRA / DFSA)

The CO/MLRO is a senior control function holder, with primary responsibility for regulatory compliance, AML/CFT oversight, licensing, and governance businesses regulated by the FSRA, DFSA and/or VAR in the UAE.
q: University degree in law, compliance, finance, risk management, or a related discipline.
Relevant compliance and regulatory experience, with strong exposure to virtual assets, digital assets, or crypto exchange businesses.
Prior experience as an Approved Person, Compliance Officer, MLRO, or Head of Compliance in a regulated environment.
Strong working knowledge of FSRA and DFSA regulatory experience is highly desirable.
Hands-on experience with AML/KYC frameworks. Ability to operate independently with sound judgment, seniority, integrity, and regulatory credibility.

Disclaimer: Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.
r: Lead and manage end-to-end licensing, authorization, and variation of permission applications with the FSRA, DFSA, and VARA for digital asset, virtual asset, and crypto exchange activities.
Act as the primary regulatory liaison for all license applications, regulatory submissions, and post-authorization supervisory engagements.
Prepare and oversee regulatory business plans, compliance frameworks, AML/CTF frameworks, governance documents, and Approved Person submissions required for authorization.
Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, information requests, thematic reviews, and inspections conducted by FSRA, DFSA, or VARA.
Ensure ongoing compliance with license conditions, regulatory commitments, and supervisory action plans.
Serve as the principal point of contact with the FSRA and DFSA for all compliance matters.
Design, implement, and maintain compliance frameworks tailored to virtual assets, digital assets, and crypto exchange operations.
Ensure compliance across products including token listings, spot trading, wallets, custody solutions, staking, and stablecoins.
Monitor regulatory developments impacting digital assets (FSRA, DFSA, VARA awareness) and ensure timely policy updates.
Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring Programme and annual compliance plan.
Oversee all regulatory filings, notifications, approvals, and periodic reporting obligations.
Provide regular compliance reporting to the Senior Executive Officer (SEO), Governing Body, and Board committees.
Act as the MLRO and primary point of contact with the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and competent authorities.
Establish, implement, and maintain AML/CFT, sanctions, and counter-proliferation financing frameworks aligned with FSRA and DFSA AML Rulebooks.
Oversee crypto-specific AML controls including blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools.
Ensure compliance with Travel Rule requirements, ongoing monitoring obligations, and STR/SAR reporting.
Conduct enterprise-wide AML and financial crime risk assessments covering custody risks, smart contract risks, cross-border flows, and fraud typologies.
Deliver AML/CFT training to staff, senior management, and Board members.
Advise the Board and senior management on regulatory risks and compliance matters. Identify, assess, and mitigate regulatory, operational, and financial crime risks.
Coordinate regulatory audits, inspections, and independent reviews, managing remediation actions to closure.
Maintain regulatory registers including breaches, complaints, training records, regulatory correspondence, and suspicious transactions.
Embed compliance-by-design principles within technology, product development, and blockchain integrations.

d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

Serving as the key point of contact within Legal for key product lines which may include equities and tokenized securities product, taking charge of Binance's legal needs and obligations for tokenized securities and stock trading products and services, and coordinating with other Legal teams (such as Commercial, Corporate, Regulatory, Data Privacy, Litigation, etc.) and cross-functional teams (such as Compliance, Risk, Marketing, Business Development, Customer Support, Tax, etc.)
Advising on ad hoc regulatory issues

Facilitating product development through the full product life-cycle (i.e. design, launch, ongoing advisory, etc.), identifying and mitigating Legal risks specific to tokenized securities and traditional financial instruments
Advising on regulatory compliance and implementation, with a focus on securities and financial instruments regulation as well as digital assets regulation

Drafting, amending, and/or negotiating existing or new product-centric terms and commercial contracts, including brokerage agreements, tokenization agreements, trading terms, and partner contracts, and preparing templates with a view to mitigating risk
Advising on product-related marketing, announcements and social media campaigns, ensuring compliance with financial promotion and advertising rules applicable to tokenized securities
Advising on client complaints and disputes alongside litigation colleagues, including matters related to tokenized securities and equities trading
Managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders and coordinating with colleagues across jurisdictions and time zones
Working with and advising cross-functional teams (e.g. Marketing, Business Development, Customer Support) to drive user acquisition and retention for equities products
Keeping up-to-date with industry/market trends and research on product-centric regulatory issues, particularly at the intersection of tokenized securities, traditional equities, and digital assets
Anticipating new ideas and identifying legal issues for Binance in the end-to-end planning and execution process for equities and tokenized securities products on Binance's ecosystem
Supporting licensing initiatives and other internal projects related to tokenized securities and stock trading
Developing creative solutions to meet current and evolving business needs
Knowledge sharing — delivering training and creating internal guidance for colleagues within and outside of Legal
Managing engagement of external counsel in line with internal policies and procedures
q: Qualified lawyer with a minimum of 4–10 years of experience in a law firm, financial services firm, or a fast-paced technology company
Deep knowledge of securities and financial instruments regulation, including experience with brokerage licensing, securities trading rules, and financial market infrastructure
Confidence in engaging with senior stakeholders and delivering trusted, commercially minded legal advice
Ability to effectively multi-task and prioritize across stakeholders/business units
Experience in product counseling on privacy, data protection, intellectual property, or technology transactions/litigation would be advantageous
Demonstrates a hands-on and proactive attitude and the ability to work independently in managing complex projects
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional business teams and maintain relationships with the necessary regulatory and compliance stakeholders
Strong team player with business acumen and excellent communication skills
Keen interest in the crypto world and digital assets markets — experience bridging traditional finance with tokenized securities or crypto/Web3 is a plus
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
